verdict.rationale: Fathom is a meeting recorder, so calendar connection and auto-capture rules are a fair question for it. The evidence pack never documents connecting a Google or Outlook calendar, and it shows no per-meeting-type auto-record rules. The meeting_type values (fathom-docs-66) only filter already-recorded meetings in the API, which is an adjacent feature rather than a capture rule.

support.subject: As a product manager, I connect Google or Outlook calendar once and control per-meeting-type rules for which meetings get captured automatically
